correctness.rationale: In K_{a,b} with a,b>=2, any nonempty distance-preserving partial injection has exactly one part-preserving or part-swapping orientation: within-part pairs have graph distance two, cross-part pairs distance one, singleton sources still determine the target part. A nilpotent injection is a labeled assembly of directed paths without cycles, with index the longest path vertex count and rank its arrow count; the two orientation-class exponential EGFs P_L and Q_L count all such assemblies and overlap only at the empty map. Finite bidegree extraction and successive cutoffs give exact full rank-index polynomial. Comparing maximal within-side path length a versus alternating length 2b+1 (a>=b), with disjoint mechanism counting at the tie a=2b+1, proves all four phase formulas. Independently enumerated every partial injection and tested every distance pair and orbit cycle for K_2,2, K_3,2, K_4,2, K_5,2 and K_3,3, reproducing index histograms 1,24,8,8 and 1,56,60,24,12 and 1,138,224,120,48, plus extremal index/count for all five instances. The general result rests on symbolic combinatorial arguments, not small enumerations.
